text:
sarah: Heads-up: customer reported increased latency and duplicate-charges after upgrading to redwood-py 1.26. Symptoms: two identical requests, auth refresh logs, and retry amplification. Seen this before? @raj

raj: Seen similar. 1.26 changed default retry behavior + moved some auth header logic into transport layer. Can you paste a repro?

sarah: Repro steps from customer (sanitized):

1) pip install redwood==1.26
2) run script

Script:
```python
from redwood import RedwoodClient
import os
c = RedwoodClient(api_key=os.environ['REDWOOD_API_KEY'])
resp = c.completions.create(model='redwood-7b', prompt='hi')
print(resp)
```

Logs show two outbound POSTs within 30ms and both billed.

mike: :eyes: important — also noticed docs don't mention the retry/header change in the migration notes.

linda: What headers do we see? was an idempotency key present?

sarah: No idempotency key. Logs:
```
INFO outbound POST /v1/complete 200 X-Request-Id: abc
INFO outbound POST /v1/complete 200 X-Request-Id: abc
WARN auth refresh attempted
```
Customer says billing counted both.

raj: Root cause: 1.26 introduced transient 'auth refresh on 401' that triggers request replay but also changed the retry backoff (shorter) and added a duplicate code path that didn't carry idempotency header if user hadn't set X-Idempotency-Key. So retries happen and look like separate requests to billing.

mike: Immediate workaround: pin to 1.24.x or set explicit idempotency header in client call.
Example:
```python
resp = c.completions.create(..., headers={'X-Idempotency-Key': 'mykey-123'})
```

sarah: Customer wants quick pin guidance. Recommend wording?

raj: Recommend: 'Pin to redwood==1.24.* until 1.26.1 is released' — patch is in PR: https://github.com/redwood/repo/pull/4567 fixes replay path and preserves idempotency header. ETA for patch: review + canary today, rollout tomorrow.

ci-bot: Deployment: canary rolled out to 10% at 3501239955 — no spike observed in canary.

linda: I'll draft support reply: explain cause, immediate pin, optionally add env var REDWOOD_DISABLE_AUTO_RETRY=true as temporary guard.

mike: I'll add a short note to the migration guide and release notes.

sarah: Thanks team — I'll reply to customer with pin + temp env var + ask for sample request IDs. :thumbsup:
